subject.description: The tech.tokimeki.forum.message or tech.tokimeki.forum.thread being reacted to.

main.description: An emoji reaction to a message or thread. Written into the reactor's own repo within the space. rkey is derived from the subject URI and the emoji ('r' + base32lower(sha256(uri + '\n' + emoji))[0:26]) so one reactor has at most one record per (subject, emoji).
